spans.s:
The augment आनुक् is added to the Proper Nouns 1. इन्द्र 2. वरुण 3. भव 4. शर्व 5. रुद्र and 6. मृड and to the words 1. हिम 'snow' 3. अरण्य 'forest' 4. यव 'barely' 5. यवन 'a Yavana' 6. मातुल 'a maternal uncle' and 7. आचार्य 'a perceptor', before the feminine affix ङीष्।

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीष्

The word इन्द्रियम् (having उदात्त (acute accent) on the last) is anomalous meaning 'an organ of sense' and so called either because it is 'the characteristic from which the existence of इन्द्र is inferred' or 'it is seen by इन्द्र ' or 'it is created by इन्द्र ' or it is wished by इन्द्र ' or 'it is given by इन्द्र '.

Terms:

The substitution of अव for the ओ of गो is compulsory when a vowel to be found in the word इन्द्र follows it.

Terms: संहितायाम्
